title: Atomic expansion request persistence
description: Objective: land the missing durable current ExpansionPlanningHoldState and its exactly bound EXPANSION PlanningRun so later admission reads authority rather than test/request fixtures. Hard dependencies: task-e62e3828df234c66969a99b8223487f4 and task-2d37939dddde447bb98e53a2bd9e6c60 DONE. Deliverable: a focused daemon planning service and handler that accepts an authenticated `graph.request_expansion`, reads the daemon-current goal/parent/run plus production safe-release authority, runs the core hold reducer and production `bindCurrentExpansionHold`, opens the EXPANSION PlanningRun with that binding, and commits the hold and run atomically with exact replay. Consumer: task-c4171c1cfe854cb78dd233794b342025. NOT in scope: scheduler admission, preparation/approval, children, resources/budget reservation, or graph activation. Owned paths: focused apps/daemon/src/planning expansion-request contract/service/ledger/tests and the narrow daemon command-registry entry after task-9cba extraction is DONE. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test.
definitionOfDone: Authenticated production ingress exposes one exact `graph.request_expansion` payload that contains rationale and subject refs only; project, principal, current goal/graph/hold/run counters, safe-release evidence, and handoff are read or derived by daemon production code and cannot be caller-replaced.

One store transaction runs the real core hold reducer, production current-hold binding, and real PlanningRun reducer, then commits the complete reducer-produced ACTIVE hold state plus the bound EXPANSION PlanningRun together; a crash or injected failure cannot persist only one side.

The durable relation uniquely selects the current hold by project, goal, parent run/node, planningRunRef, generation, graph epoch, and hold version; strict readers reject absent, foreign, stale, terminal, malformed, conflicting, or split records with stable exact code/layer and no authority.
Identical command replay is byte-identical; same-id/different-bytes and concurrent request/cancel/goal-epoch movement produce one winner or exact refusal and never two active holds/runs.

File-backed SQLite tests close before reopen on Windows, assert exact codes/layers and nonzero race/hostile counts, raw event/decision cardinality, and zero child/lease/effect/resource/budget/activation authority; mutation drills target safe-release selection and atomic hold/run commit.
taskRails: Design requires safe release, hold creation, and PlanningRun open atomically; do not seed a hold in tests, accept a caller-produced hold/binding, or commit the two aggregates in separate transactions.
Compose task-e62e's durable release reader and task-2d379's production binding surface; do not reimplement either authority.
This task stops at an ACTIVE hold and bound EXPANSION PlanningRun and mints no admission, preparation, approval, child, or graph activation authority.
Use public package roots across boundaries, exact codes/layers and positive generated counts; target <=250 lines per production source and split before 400.
